headline: Registered Nurse

notes: Related learning experience in medical-surgical, pediatric, maternity and community settings
Registered Nurse, Philippine Nurse Licensure Examination, 2024

summary: Registered nurse with a year of experience in a busy outpatient and urgent-care clinic in Tacloban. I take histories and vital signs, assess patients before they see the doctor, document care accurately and respond first in emergencies. I am calm under pressure and careful about infection control.

projects.name: Hypertension follow-up list
projects.description: Started a follow-up list for patients with uncontrolled blood pressure and called them before each visit; missed follow-ups dropped noticeably within three months.

skills: Basic Life Support (BLS) and first aid
Explaining care to patients and families

experience.title: Staff Nurse

bullets: Assess and triage about 60 outpatients a shift, taking histories and vital signs before consultation.
Monitor patients under observation and report changes to the physician on duty.
Document assessments, treatments and teaching in the clinic's electronic medical record.
